text:
alex_cheng: Quick sync—marketplace HW partner wants a "golden-path" telemetry guide for Datadog + OpenTelemetry. Need end-to-end: traces, metrics, dashboard tile, and QA checklist. Can we draft something lightweight for partners to copy/paste?

maria_gonzalez: Yes. Keep it one pager + repo with artifacts. Include a demo script, a dashboard JSON, and a short security note.

sam_taylor: From runtime: important bits are span naming (inference.request.start / inference.kv_cache.hit), KV cache metrics, and a note about batching affecting trace spans. Also include an example OTLP exporter config and header auth snippet.

jordan_liu: I'll prepare a minimal collector config that exports to Datadog and writes a local file for debugging. We'll keep ports + env var examples for private installs.

nina_ops: Ops input: add a short incident playbook—what to check when traces disappear or p99 spikes (GPU util, queue depth, prefix cache hit). Also include alert thresholds.

observability-bot: Templates available: partners/telemetry-golden-path/v1/templates.tar.gz (contains dashboard JSON, collector snippet, demo script).

alex_cheng: Draft checklist proposal: - OTLP receiver + Datadog exporter example - Copyable collector.yaml - Span naming best-practices + example trace of a full request - Dashboard JSON: p99 latency, token rate, gpu_util, kv_cache_hit, batch_size dist - Sampling guidance (head vs tail sampler) - Alert rules + short runbook snippets - Marketplace QA steps (tile renders, screenshot, PII check)

maria_gonzalez: Add licensing note for bundled assets and a short step to validate screenshots in Datadog's tile viewer. Also add a short "what's expected in trace payload" section so partners don't send PII.

sam_taylor: Collector snippet to include in the doc:

```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      http:
      grpc:
processors:
  batch:
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: "<DD_API_KEY>"
  file:
    path: "/tmp/otlp-debug.json"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [datadog, file]
```

jordan_liu: Security appendix: show setting DD_API_KEY via env var and KMS integration example. Note network egress ports: 4317 (OTLP gRPC) and 4318 (OTLP HTTP). For on-prem connector show HMAC header sample.

nina_ops: Example alert + runbook: - Alert: inference_p99 > 500ms for 5m -> Runbook: check node GPU %util, router queue length, cache hit rate. If error rate >20%, flip to fallback model and paged team.

alex_cheng: Timeline: first draft + artifacts by next Wednesday, internal review Tuesday 10am. Owners?

maria_gonzalez: I'll own partner-facing copy and QA with marketplace team.

sam_taylor: I'll produce span examples and sample trace export.

jordan_liu: I'll export Datadog dashboard JSON and write the network/security appendix.

nina_ops: I'll draft incident playbook and alert defs.

alex_cheng: I'll assemble into partners/telemetry-golden-path and request design for a one-page checklist graphic. Ping obs-bot for templates. :thumbsup:

observability-bot: Uploaded templates to repo.

maria_gonzalez: Scheduling a 20-min review Tuesday 10am. Please drop artifacts in the repo before then.

sam_taylor: Will do. I'll also attach a short curl demo that generates a trace id you can look up in Datadog.

jordan_liu: Added dashboard export to the repo.

nina_ops: Runbook draft added. Leave comments in PR.

alex_cheng: Thanks everyone. Goal: simple, reproducible onboarding for partners so listings show a working dashboard/tile on day 1. :rocket:
